lang.description: BCP 47 tag of this translation. Sets the popup language, number format and plural rules.

extName.description: Extension name. A brand name: do not translate.

extDescription.message: Refuses every cookie banner before you see it. Or approves them all. Either way, you never see one again.
extDescription.description: Store and browser description. At most 132 characters.

statusArmed.description: Top-right status: the extension is answering banners on this site.

statusPaused.description: Top-right status: the user paused it on this site.

statusIdle.description: Top-right status: a browser page where extensions cannot run.

statusNoAccess.description: Top-right status: the browser has not given the extension access to this site.

headlineReject.description: Big headline in refuse mode. Keep it short.

headlineAccept.description: Big headline in approve mode. Keep it short.

headlinePaused.description: Big headline when paused on this site.

headlineNoAccess.description: Big headline when the browser has not given access to this site.

subReject.message: EVERY BANNER ANSWERED NO. BEFORE YOU SEE IT.
subReject.description: Line under the headline in refuse mode.

subAccept.message: EVERY BANNER ANSWERED YES. BEFORE YOU SEE IT.
subAccept.description: Line under the headline in approve mode.

subPaused.message: THIS SITE GETS ITS BANNERS BACK.
subPaused.description: Line under the headline when paused on this site.

subNoAccess.message: THE BROWSER HASN'T LET IT RUN ON THIS SITE.
subNoAccess.description: Line under the headline without site access.

modeLabel.description: Screen reader label of the REFUSE / APPROVE switch. Sentence case.

systemPage.description: Shown instead of a site name on browser pages.

detailNone.description: Status line: nothing to answer on this page.

detailPaused.description: Status line: paused, or no access, on this site.

detailOffLimits.description: Status line on browser pages, where extensions cannot run.

detailNoAccessManual.message: ALLOW IT IN THE BROWSER'S EXTENSION SETTINGS.
detailNoAccessManual.description: Status line without site access, when the popup cannot ask for it.

verbReject.description: After a consent platform name: "ONETRUST — REFUSED".

verbAccept.description: After a consent platform name: "ONETRUST — APPROVED".

verbHide.description: After a consent platform name: hidden without answering (no way to refuse).

verbOther.description: After a consent platform name, for anything else.

allowAccess.description: Button that asks the browser for access to all sites.

statusReload.description: Top-right status: the page loaded before the extension could run in it.

headlineReload.description: Big headline when the page has to be reloaded once.

subReload.message: THIS PAGE LOADED BEFORE IT COULD RUN.
subReload.description: Line under the headline: the page was open before the extension started.

reloadPage.description: Button that reloads the current tab.

tallyOne.description: Lifetime counter, plural category "one". {n} is the number. Add tallyZero, tallyTwo, tallyFew or tallyMany where your language needs them.

tallyOther.description: Lifetime counter, every other number. {n} is the number.

report.description: Link: report a problem with this site.

reportLabel.message: Report a problem on this site (opens GitHub)
reportLabel.description: Screen reader label and tooltip of REPORT. Must contain the visible word.

donateLabel.message: Donate to keep it free (opens GitHub)
donateLabel.description: Screen reader label and tooltip of DONATE. Must contain the visible word.
